messages.author: Debarati DasGupta
messages.body:
Anyone on this list who has used AMBER22 extensively for RNA simulations?
Any tutorials/web links/documentations one can share?
I am learning to use AMBER for RNA small molecule simulations and I am interested in seeing if people on this community have some insights/guidance for me.
Regards,
Debarati

messages.author: Carlos Simmerling
messages.body:
I would read the recent papers of Christina Bergonzo and/or Tom Cheatham,
these probably give valuable advice.
